name: apiKey
label: API key
help: Enter your API key without the `Bearer` prefix. For example, `pak_live_…` or the public test key `pak_test_X0001`. To create an account and get a live API key, see the [Starter Package](https://parser-api.micro-ki.de/starten) and the [English API documentation (PDF)](https://parser-api.micro-ki.de/doku/make.en.pdf).
